title: Core style definitions
description: Definitions that every domain shares. A domain schema refers to these with $ref. A style id is unique across all domains.

slug.description: Kebab-case id. It is equal to the file name without the extension.

score.description: An ordinal position on a 1 to 5 axis. The domain manifest names the two poles.

end.description: Last year of the peak. null = still in active use.

core_thesis.description: One sentence. The claim about the world that this style makes.

design_principles.description: Imperative rules that an agent can execute. Each rule names a concrete property or measure.

anti_patterns.description: What breaks the style. Written as the thing to avoid, without a leading "never" or "do not". These become the NEVER guardrails.

evolved_from.description: Direct ancestors in the same domain.

hybridized_with.description: Styles that this style mixes with in practice. The graph makes this edge symmetric.

echoes.description: Kin in a DIFFERENT domain (for example a UI style and an architecture style that share a thesis).

subgenre_of.description: The one parent style in the same domain when this style is a narrower branch of it (Synthetism of Post-Impressionism). The sub-genre has its own visual recipe; without one it is an organisation or a scene, not a sub-genre.

root.description: Only for a style with no edge: the reason why it has no ancestor in the data. Rule 1 of the curation rules needs an edge or this reason.

agent.description: Routing data. An orchestrator reads this to decide when to load the skill and where to go when the user asks for a variation.

triggers.description: Lower-case words and phrases a user says when they want this style.

use_cases.description: Products or artefacts where the style works well.

avoid_when.description: Conditions where the style is the wrong choice.

request.description: The variation the user asks for: "softer", "bolder", "more corporate".

how.description: Which properties to change, and which to keep.

permutations.description: Rule 6 of the curation rules. The range of each knob of the domain (domains/<domain>.json `knobs`) inside which the style stays itself. A key is a knob key. If the knob reads its default from a token, leave out `default`.

evidence.description: Canonical evidence for the style that anyone may reuse: each item has an open licence or is in the public domain. The repository stores the link, the credit and the licence, never the file. The demo loads an image, a font or an icon from `file` by URL.

kind.description: image: a photo or a scan of a work. font: an open font file. icon-set: an open icon set, with one icon as `file`. document: a text or a specimen book.

url.description: The page of the item: the Commons file page, the repository or the font page.

file.description: A direct link to the file that the demo shows: an image, a font (woff2, ttf, otf) or an SVG icon.
